name: forge-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Forge. NOT DEPLOYED — requires the Blaze plan.
$comment: `main` points into lib/functions/ because tsconfig's rootDir reaches up to the repo root, so the app's pure judging engine compiles in alongside these functions rather than being duplicated.

scripts.$comment_verify: Emulator verification lives in the ROOT package.json as `npm run test:functions`, because that is where firebase.json and the firebase-tools binary are.
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
